Hum Dono Milke is a song from the 1978 movie Tumhari Kasam starring Jeetendra, Moushmi Chatterjee, Navin Nischol and Padmini Kapila. Enjoy listening to the song.
Song : Hum Dono Milke
Movie: Tumhari Kasam
Singers: Mukesh, Asha Bhosle
Lyrics: Anand Bakshi
Music : Rajesh Roshan
